description: Roth IRA 5-Year Rule + Distribution Tax — Is a Roth IRA withdrawal qualified, and what is taxed or penalized? Required: age (on distribution date), first_year (tax year of first Roth IRA contribution or conversion), amount (USD). Optional: date (YYYY-MM-DD, default today), contributions (total regular contributions), conversions (year:amount;year:amount), prior_distributions, reason (disability|death|first_home|medical|education|sepp|birth_adoption|health_insurance|qualified_disaster|terminal_illness|emergency|domestic_abuse|irs_levy|reservist), first_home_used. Applies the IRS ordering rules (contributions, then conversions oldest-first, then earnings), the account 5-year clock and each conversion's own 5-year penalty clock. Returns layers with tax and 10% penalty, verdict QUALIFIED_TAX_FREE/NONQUALIFIED_BUT_TAX_FREE/TAXABLE_NO_PENALTY/TAXABLE_AND_PENALTY. Offline. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_roth_5_year
